# fread (card file)

Reads from an open card file.

**Category:** function · **Address:** `0x606320f2` (runtime cached) · <span class="pill pill-released">Camera-confirmed</span>
{ .facts }

**Build:** [E-M5 Mark III firmware 1.7, build 1700](../firmware/em5-iii-1700.md) · **Cameras:** [Olympus OM-D E-M5 Mark III](../cameras/em5-iii.md)

Easily confused with fwrite next to it; a logger that called this by mistake wrote nothing.

## Observations

- **Physical camera** ([Olympus firmware notes (E-M5 Mark III)](../projects/em5-iii-notes.md)): Request files read with it on the camera. Source: [Gotchas](../sources/em5n.gotchas.md).
